build_RotaryEmbedding: build a RotaryEmbedding module with a given dimension and frequency type for language or pixel data
apply_apply_rotary_emb: apply rotary embeddings to query or key tensors using precomputed frequency tensors
rotate_rotate_queries_and_keys: rotate both queries and keys together using xpos extrapolatable rotary embeddings with scaling
create_Rope2D: create a Rope2D helper class to apply 2D rotary positional embeddings on grid-shaped feature maps
apply_apply_learned_rotations: apply learned rotation vectors to tensors with optional frequency range masking
